basis.method: Read-only comparison of all remaining checklist items with saved manifest IDs, construction modules and selected existing evidence/validation reports. No CAD was rebuilt and no physical production fit was newly verified.
basis.indexing: checklist_indexes are zero-based indexes within the named system's items array.
basis.status_policy: present_provisional means saved geometry exists, not completion. partial means some represented geometry plus explicit missing construction. missing means no representation found within this engine scope, not proof a production component exists. verification_required means the checklist correctly asks for accuracy beyond geometry presence. staged_not_installed distinguishes isolated code from the cited frozen manifest. No whole checklist item is marked OEM-verified.
